description: Grok's webhook: an agent pushes a message to the owner's Grok bot with `kith send-to grok "text"`; one profile per bot (grok/kai, grok/work). Grok's answer comes back on its bot link, not here

webhook.sent: Grok started a run, not that it replied
webhook.not_started: Grok answered 2xx but did not start a run (no "success":true)

status_messages.400: Grok's routine is paused (disabled); the message was not delivered
status_messages.401: Grok refused the key (401); replace it via request_secret / kith-auth set grok/<account> GROK_WEBHOOK_KEY

webhook.limits: Grok allows 300 runs/hour across all routines and 200/hour per routine; over a cap the run fails silently (no HTTP error), so a 200 can still end in no run
